answer: Mechanism: Sustained-Attention Retention Curve (SARC). Each agent identity is tied to a private challenge kernel that emits unpredictable, low-stakes micro-decisions over weeks; only timely, consistent responses build a reputation signal. Trust rises toward a zenith only after long uninterrupted participation. An attacker running N sybils must provision N independent attention streams—human operators or latency-stable models—so the opportunity cost of sustained attention scales linearly with identities; shared multiplexing produces detectable timing correlation and missed probes reset decay.
